title: Platform definitions shared by every site

SiteId.description: A site pack's id, e.g. the folder name under sites/.

ToolName.description: A site tool or a platform presentation tool. Checked against the active site pack at runtime.

EntityKind.description: A kind of item the site shows, such as a product, an offer or an account: an entity kind the site pack declares.

EntityId.description: An ID a tool returned in this conversation, or the item on screen. Its kind comes from the site pack.

FieldKey.description: A field of that kind of item, as the site pack declares it.

DateTime.description: ISO 8601 date and time with a time zone. A pattern rather than format: date-time, so validators need no format library at runtime.

estimated.description: The site's own guess at where the user is (from their network address, say), not a place the user gave; the agent says which one it used, so the user can correct it.

Fenced.description: Third-party text after the sanitizer: control characters removed, length capped, wrapped in a labeled fence.
